messages:
maria: Heads-up — opened PR #4624 with a hybrid Flash+Paged fused attention kernel. Needs quick smoke perf across our target shapes. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/4624. Can folks run microbenches for seq=1k/2k/4k and batch sizes 1/8/32 on a100-40g and v100?

devon: On it. Which commit SHA should we run?

maria: SHA: 9f8b2a1. I toggled page-fusion with -DENABLE_PAGE_FUSION=1. FP16 path unchanged.

kai: I can run on a100-80g in eu-west tonight at ~15:00 UTC. Will do batch=1/8/32 and post logs.

anjali: I can cover v100 in us-west but limited to seq<=2048. Please run with profiler enabled: export RUNTIME_PROF=1 so we get kernel timings.

perf-bot: perf-bot: scheduled benchmark job 1719123465 for sha 9f8b2a1 on a100-40g. link: https://perf.internal/1719123465

devon: Quick note: set CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING=1 when collecting nsight traces to avoid interleaved kernels.

kai: Run results (a100-80g): batch=1 seq=1024 -> median 28ms/token, p95 38ms. Baseline (main) was ~24/32. Attaching compressed log: /tmp/bench-kai-1719123478.log.gz

maria: Thanks. That's a small regression at 1k. Can someone re-run with KV cache warm (flag --kv-warm) to see if it's a cold-start effect?

anjali: I ran seq=2048 batch=8 on v100. median=62ms/token vs baseline 65ms. Slightly better. Profiler shows an extra memcpy in fused path ~1.1ms. Snippet: ```GPU memcpy HtoD: 1.12ms```

devon: I reviewed the PR and found a miscompute in the paged prefetch stride for odd-block sizes — likely causing the memcpy. I'll push a fix to the branch in a few mins.

maria: If devon pushes the fix, can perf-bot re-run the nightly regression on the dedicated branch? Also please add the `perf/required` label on the PR.

sre-bot: sre-bot: gpu-slot reserve confirmed for 1719123500-1719123800 on a100-eu-west for maria,kai.

perf-bot: perf-bot: re-run queued after PR update. ETA ~30m.

kai: Also, please avoid running heavy suites during canary windows. Prefer off-peak 02:00-06:00 UTC for large matrices.

maria: Agreed — I'll update the PR description with the run matrix, preferred windows, and instructions for `RUNTIME_PROF` + `CUDA_LAUNCH_BLOCKING`. Thanks everyone!
